text:
sunita: Quick sync — KV rollup milestone this week. Where are we on kernel patch, prefetch, and eviction fixes?
ashwin: Kernel patch is in review (PR 4217). Need a perf run after the merge; observed a small regression in tail on microbatch tests.
dave: I can own the fallback path for tiny batches and add unit tests. Will carve out time today.
lucy: I can run targeted load tests for prefetch/warmup scenarios. Share the scripts and target QPS.
ashwin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4217 — CI passed but perf-run failed on eviction shadow case.
sunita: @dave who is the primary on eviction policy right now? We need clear owner for rollout gating.
dave: Taking ownership for eviction/fallback. I'll add a small perf synthetic and a repro script. ETA Tue EOD.
jen: The eviction hiccup looks related to the warmup change from last sprint — I can revert the tweak and re-run.
ashwin: After revert, can you run `tools/perf/run_microbatch.sh --seq 2k` and drop flamegraphs? Seeing ~3% tail increase on that config.
jen: On it. Will run locally and upload flamegraphs to the PR.
lucy: I'll also run a 6-hour soak on a dedicated 16g GPU instance once the canary is live. Helps catch slow ramps.
sunita: Ops: canary plan is Friday 10% -> 50% if healthy. Key checks: token-latency P95/P99, KV hit-rate, eviction rate. Add anything else?
ashwin: Add: continuous-batching acceptance test (small/large seq) and microbatch tail measurement.
dave: Adding `tests/perf/evict_repro.sh` and a short unit to assert fallback correctness.
jen: Opening revert PR now, will tag @ashwin for perf runs.
ops-bot: Deploy queued: canary -> staging at 18:00 UTC (ticket INF-1329).
sunita: Also please enable kv_warmup flag for the canary: `kv_warmup=true` in deployment config.
ashwin: Ack, I'll include the flag in the canary manifest and run perf harness after deploy.
lucy: If canary looks green, I can extend soak and run stress loader for 2x QPS.
sunita: Sounds good. If no major blockers, milestone "kv-rollup-canary" moves to READY. :thumbsup:
ashwin: ack
dave: ack
jen: ack
ops-bot: Canary deploy started at 18:00 UTC
ops-bot: Canary health checks: token-latency P95 stable, KV hit-rate +0.7%, eviction rate within expected bounds.
sunita: Thanks team — we'll collect perf artifacts and reconvene async if anything pops up.
